Plus tax, the $8.50 reservation fee when booked online, and a park entry permit ($7 a day for a Nebraska vehicle, $14 otherwise; $35 / $70 a year). Nebraska Game and Parks' camping rates grid ('These rates are consistent across all parks'), matched on its booking site for June 2027 nights, read 2026-10-12.

source: https://outdoornebraska.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2025-Camping-Rates-Grid.pdf (row 'Willow Creek', linked from https://outdoornebraska.gov/parks/park-pricing/) + nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com (June 2027 quotes at Branched Oak and Lake McConaughy match it), read 2026-10-12
